channel.name: Hero reminders
channel.description: Daily, weekly and monthly reminders in your hero's voice.

morning: Dawn over the realm, brave one! Today's quests await your valour.
The morning trumpets sound! A new day of deeds awaits you, brave one.
The sun is rising and your sword is already polished. Which quest opens the dance, brave one?
The day is an empty battlefield: fill it with small victories, brave one.
By a thousand shields! It's morning and the quests are calling. Answer, brave one!
The realm is waking and counts on you. One quest at a time, like every legend.
May dawn find you sword in hand, brave one: the first quest is the noblest.
Put on the armour of habit! Today the dragon of deadlines trembles.
Glory to those who start early! Today's quests await, brave one.
A new day, a new oath to honour. Onward, brave one!
evening: The sun sets and duty calls: one last charge before dusk?
The torches are lit on the walls, brave one. One quest remains to be done.
Evening falls over the realm: there's still time for a deed worthy of a ballad.
Dusk is the hour of diligent knights, brave one. One quest and you rest like a hero.
The vesper bells ring. One last sword stroke and the day is yours!
The realm is nearly asleep. One more quest, and you'll sleep like a paladin.
Even the bravest knights end the day with a feat. What's yours?
The dragon of deadlines yawns. Strike it with a quest before dinner!
Sunset reddens the horizon, brave one: one last act of courage awaits you.
At day's end, valour is measured in quests completed. One more, brave one?
streak: {n} days of oath honoured, brave one! The trail stays open: one small step tonight, if you like.
The realm remembers your {n} days of valour. One quest, however small, and the tale goes on.
Brave one, {n} days on the road! Tonight the banner may rest, or rise again: your choice.
{n} days in a row: a chronicle worthy of minstrels. Shall we write one more line tonight?
Your {n}-day streak still shines. One gentle quest and it will shine even more.
The castle has been at peace for {n} days, brave one. One quest tonight keeps the torches lit.
{n} days, and your oath has not wavered. The trail awaits, no hurry.
Brave one, {n} days of effort deserve a toast. Perhaps after one small quest?
The realm's book holds {n} days in your name. A new line tonight, if you wish.
{n} days in a row! The realm is proud of you. One more quest, and you sleep like a paladin.
comeback: The realm awaits you, brave one. No scolding: one quest is enough to take the road again.
Your shield is still in its place, brave one. Whenever you like, we start again with one quest.
The castle halls are quiet without you. Come back whenever you like, brave one.
Every knight has days of rest. Your road restarts wherever you want.
The dragon of deadlines still sleeps. One small quest and you're back in the saddle.
Your seat at the round table is always free, brave one. One quest and you're one of us.
No hurry, noble knight: the realm is patient. One tiny little quest?
Your sword is polished and waiting. Even a single step is a feat.
The squire has kept your horse saddled. Whenever you like, brave one, we ride.
The realm still needs you, and cares for you all the same. Come back at your own pace.
weekly: The week calls you to arms, brave one: the weekly quests await your valour.
A week is a small campaign. Which deeds will you bring to completion, brave one?
The week's quests wait on the council table. A glance, brave one?
Every week is an epic in seven acts. Your weekly quests are waiting.
Brave one, the week's map is open: there's still glory to be won.
Seven days, one knight: you. The weekly quests await your nod.
The realm's chronicler is preparing the week's account. What will he write about you?
One weekly deed is worth four dailies! The maths of knights, brave one.
The week still has room for a memorable deed. Might it be this one, brave one?
The trumpets announce the week: the weekly quests are ready for the challenge.
monthly: The month is a great campaign, brave one: the monthly quests await your valour.
A month, a great deed. The monthly quests await you in the throne room.
Brave one, the month's quests are the noblest and worth twelve dailies!
The realm's calendar is clear: the monthly deeds await a gesture from you.
A whole month of possible glory. Take a look at the monthly quests, brave one.
Great deeds are done one step a day. The month's ones are waiting for you.
The realm's chronicler is preparing the month's pages. Would you like to dictate a deed?
Monthly quests are the real dragons, brave one. Shall we face one?
The month still has time for a memorable victory. The monthly quests wait.
The month's bells ring: the monthly deeds are ready to be honoured.
levelup: New level, sharper sword! The realm salutes you, brave one.
By a thousand shields, you've reached a new level! A ballad shall be written.
The trumpets sound for you, brave one: your valour grows!
You've won another battle against habit. The realm is proud.
One step higher on the ladder of glory! Onward, brave one.
Your armour shines a little brighter. The oath is kept.
The dragon of deadlines retreats a step. Well done, brave one!
The king himself notes your progress. New level, new honour.
New level, and your shield bears the pride of it (dent included).
Brave one, this level is yours: earned quest after quest.

morning: Dawn. Three quests. No noise.
The day begins. Move slowly. Move well.
One quest. Then another. Like this.
The monastery is awake. So are you.
Silence outside. Quests inside.
The shadow rises with the sun. Your turn.
Today one step is enough. Then the next.
One breath. Then the first quest.
No hurry. No delay.
The day is empty. Fill it calmly.
evening: The shadow falls. One remains.
Evening. One more quest.
The lanterns are lit. One is for you.
The day is closing. Close it well.
Few words: one quest, then rest.
Sunset doesn't wait. You may, but not long.
Only one thing is left. Do it softly.
Night is near. One last step.
The monastery is silent. Your day can be too.
One quest. Then dark and quiet.
streak: {n} days. The path is open. One step tonight, if you wish.
{n} lanterns lit. One more, if you like.
{n} days of discipline. No hurry. One quest is enough.
{n} days of good silence. The monastery awaits.
The chain is {n} days long. It can grow, slowly.
{n} days. The master nods. Tonight, one small step.
You have been here {n} days. Tonight there is room for one quest.
{n} days. Breathe. Then, if you wish, one quest.
The path counts {n} days. It stays open.
{n} days of constancy. One quest, then rest.
comeback: The monastery awaits you. No hurry.
A pause is only a pause. Resume when you wish.
The lantern is lit. One step is enough.
No scolding. One small quest.
The shadow remains. It waits.
The path is there. One step, no more.
Remember the first day? Today, too, little is enough.
Silence does not judge. Return.
One quest. Then see.
Every return is a beginning. Yours is already ready.
weekly: The week is open. The weekly quests wait.
Seven days. Few quests. Choose.
The week's cycle goes on. A glance at the tasks.
The week breathes. Its quests wait.
A patient shadow completes its weekly quests.
Week in progress. One quest at a time.
The master recalls the week's quests. He barely smiles.
Seven days are enough. Use them.
Weekly quests make no noise. They make a difference.
The week asks little. One step today.
monthly: The month is long. Its quests are great.
Monthly quests. One step, then another.
The month does not repeat. Neither do its quests.
The lanterns of the month wait to be lit.
One month. One great quest. Small steps.
The month flows. The monthly quests wait.
The master watches the month. One quest is enough to begin.
The month has time. So do you. But not too much.
Monthly quests: few, heavy, precious.
The month ends sooner or later. The quests remain.
levelup: New level. No noise.
One step higher. The master nods.
You crossed a threshold. Few words: good.
One more lantern lights up. Continue.
The path rises. So do you.
Level reached. Breathe. Then onward.
Discipline pays. Slowly, but it pays.
A new step of the journey. Silence and gratitude.
The monastery notices. Nobody says it.
Higher. Without hurry.

morning: The woods are awake. Are you? Lace up your boots.
Dawn. The trail won't open itself, you know.
Good morning. Today's quests aren't done by walking in circles.
Come on: the woods have already walked half the way. The other half is yours.
Fresh morning, map open. Where do you start today?
Today's trail has three turns. I'd take the first one right now.
No morning excuses: the boots are right there, and so are the quests.
The sun is poking through the branches. Your first quest could too.
New day, new notches on the trees. Let's begin.
If you wait for the trail to draw itself, you'll wait a good while. Let's move.
evening: The trail won't walk itself. One quest before dark.
The sun is dropping behind the firs. One quest and then campfire.
Little light, a bit more road. One quest and you're home.
Before dark, one last stretch of trail. Come on.
The woods are getting dark: better to close the leg with a quest.
One more step before you make camp. Just one, promise.
The fireflies are lighting their waymarks. You've got one to light.
Leg almost finished. Only a few metres left.
Sunset is unforgiving with delays, but a quick quest isn't.
One quest, then pack down and fire up. Deal?
streak: {n} days of beaten trail. The woods are waiting, if you fancy another stretch.
You've already walked {n} days. One more notch tonight? The trail isn't going anywhere.
{n} days in a row: proper ranger stuff. One quest and we close the leg in style.
The trail has been open {n} days. Tonight one small step is enough, promise.
{n} days of steady walking. A water break is fine; a quest is even better.
Your {n}-day streak can be seen from afar. Fancy adding a notch?
{n} days on the trail and not a sermon from me. One quest, if you like.
After {n} days, the woods know you by name. One last stretch before the fire?
{n} days of regular steps. Tonight a short one, the trail is still there.
The fire is lit and the streak stands at {n} days. One quest and then rest.
comeback: The trail is still there, and so are the boots. Whenever you like, we set off.
No sermon: the woods are waiting. One quest and you're marching again.
Got a bit lost? Happens. To me too. Let's start again from here.
The map is open and the trail hasn't gone anywhere.
One step and you're back on track. The rest comes later.
The woods don't keep score. Come back whenever you like, the fire's lit.
I left a new notch for you. Come and see it.
A day off, two, three: the trail is in no hurry. Neither am I.
I stopped for a drink. I'll wait for you, we'll restart gently.
One quest is enough to put you back on the trail. Just one, promise.
weekly: The week is a long trail: the weekly quests are its stages.
Seven days of road. The weekly stages are waiting for you.
Look at the week's map: there are stages to mark.
Weekly quests are the huts along the route. Let's reach one.
A week isn't walked in one go. One stage at a time.
The woods count the days. The weekly quests are right there under the tree.
Week in progress: the big stages wait, the small ones sort themselves out.
One outing, one stage, one goal. The week has room for all three.
All good with the week's trail? Take a look at the stages.
Weekly quests are worth four dailies. Nice hut, isn't it?
monthly: The month is a crossing. The monthly quests are the peaks.
The month's peaks are visible from here: the monthly quests are waiting.
One month, a few peaks. Look at the monthly map.
Long crossings are made in small steps. The month's ones are waiting.
Monthly quests: the best part of the route. You'll get there sooner or later.
The month runs, so does the trail. Check the big stages.
One peak a month is enough. Which will you pick?
The woods have changed season. The monthly quests are still waiting.
From the top of the month you can see everything. One big quest and you're there.
Monthly quests are worth twelve dailies. Great view, I'd say.
levelup: Level up! The trail takes a nice curve uphill.
A new level: proper ranger stuff.
You've passed another fork. Not bad.
New level! I'm cutting one more notch on the tree.
Keep it up: the trail is wider now.
New level. And you didn't get lost even once. Almost.
Your notches can be seen from the summit. Well done.
A new level! The woods approve with a rustle.
You've earned a peak. Breathe, then we move on.
Level reached. From the top you see further.

morning: Good morning! I was supposed to remind you of something... oh yes, the quests!
Abracadabra! Er, no, that was another spell. Anyway: today's quests.
I woke up with a spell in my head... and your quests. Which of the two was it?
Today I forgot where I put my staff. Your quests, though, are right here.
Hello! I was about to tell you something very important. Oh yes: quests!
A little morning magic: Questus completus! (Works better if you actually do them.)
The stars say today is a great day. Or was it yesterday? Anyway: quests.
I've prepared a good-mood spell. It only needs a few completed quests.
Good day! I read in the spellbook: page “today's quests”. Lovely page.
I had a feeling I had an appointment today... oh, with your quests! Here they are.
evening: I lost my wand (it was in my pocket). Meanwhile: the quests?
Evening! The stars are coming out and quests don't complete themselves. Pity.
I lit the magic lamp to remind you of something... what was it? Oh, the quests.
The sun has gone to sleep. One quest and we'll go to sleep too.
One last spell before dinner: Questus finalis. To be done calmly.
I remember forgetting something. Perhaps tonight's quests?
The owls have started to sing. One quest and we toast with the potion.
I've been told evening is the time for little miracles. One quest?
The stars say so: one quest before bed brings sweet dreams.
Sunset potion almost ready. To make it perfect, it needs a quest.
streak: {n} days of steady magic! If I remember rightly, tonight only needs one small quest.
The spellbook says: {n}-day streak. One quest and the page fills up.
{n} days! I almost remembered where I put my hat. And you, one quest tonight?
Your {n}-day streak shines like a gem. One small spell keeps it polished.
I counted {n} days of streak, twice to be sure. Fancy one more?
{n} days of real magic. The wand is behind my ear; your next quest is right here.
Formula of the day: Questus parvus! That is: {n} days, and one small quest for tonight.
{n} days in a row: a lovely spell. No hurry, but the lantern is lit.
I seem to remember {n} days of effort. Another quest and I'll write it in the notebook.
{n} days together. I forgot what I was going to tell you, but I think it was: well done.
comeback: Hey, remember me? I forgot what I was going to tell you, but come back whenever you like.
The wand is still behind my ear. Your quests, though, are waiting for you here.
No hurry: the best spells are the ones remembered last.
I found the notebook with your progress. One step and we pick up from there.
I was thinking of you while looking for my hat. Come back whenever you like.
I got lost in the library, but your seat is always free. Come back whenever you like.
Every wizard forgets something. You can start again with just one quest.
I cast a waiting spell: it lasts until you return. No limits.
The stars are always there. So are your quests. Whenever you like.
I have a half-idea that you might come back. If you want, one quest is enough to restart.
weekly: The week is a great spell in seven words: the weekly quests are its heart.
Seven days of magic! The weekly quests are waiting in the book.
I remember there was a week to enchant. Take a look at the quests.
The week's potion needs your weekly quests. Not much, but good.
I've been told the week is passing. Shall we check the quests?
Weekly quests are long formulas: they're pronounced in instalments.
A week, a few quests, a little magic. Yours are waiting.
The week's notebook is open. The weekly quests are on page one.
The week's stars are aligned. Weekly quests, come on!
A weekly quest is worth four dailies. Magic maths, the best kind.
monthly: The month is a long spell: the monthly quests are its runes.
A month of magic! The monthly quests wait on the alchemist's table.
I found the month's list! Here it is: monthly quests at the top.
Monthly quests are ancient scrolls: they take time, but they're worth a lot.
The month's calendar opened by itself. The monthly quests say hello.
A month, an important spell. Which monthly quest will you choose?
The month runs like a magic cat. Your monthly quests are chasing it.
Monthly quests are worth twelve dailies. Pure alchemy!
If the month were a book, the monthly quests would be the title.
One rune a month is enough: the monthly quests are waiting to be carved.
levelup: Level up! I seem to remember it's a good thing. It is!
A new level! The stars shine a little brighter, or maybe it's the lamp.
Abracadabra, promotion successful! That is: new level. Oops.
You've crossed a magic threshold. I even took notes.
One more level! Wand in hand, or behind the ear.
New level: I've already forgotten the old one, but this one is lovely.
Your spell grows. Meanwhile I'm looking for my hat.
One more rank at the Academy of the Skies. Congratulations!
Level reached! I said the right formula first time, for once.
Hooray! Another level. Who would have thought? Me, maybe. I think.

morning: Good morning. Breathe: today one small step is enough.
The morning light is gentle. Your quests can be too.
A new day, new possibilities. Choose the quest that feels lightest.
Good morning. No hurry: the Lantern is lit, the steps are yours to take.
A deep breath, then one quest. The rest will follow.
You don't need to do everything today. Starting with something small is enough.
Light arrives softly and reaches everything. Your goals today too.
Good morning: you're already halfway there just by being here. Now one quest, calmly.
The day welcomes you. Which small steps would you like to take today?
A new dawn, no judgement. Just your first quest, whenever you like.
evening: No rush. One gentle quest before bed?
Evening arrives softly. One last small step and then rest.
If you feel like it, one quest before the light goes out. If not, that's fine too.
The Lantern is still lit. One light step and I'll walk you to sleep.
The day says goodbye gently. There's still a little room for a quest.
One last breath, one small quest. Then the night is all yours.
The day has already given so much. One more quest, if you feel like it.
The stars are coming out. One peaceful quest and the day closes well.
Before rest, one more small light. One quest, calmly.
No duty, just a gentle invitation: one quest before bed?
streak: You've built {n} days of light. One small one tonight is enough.
{n} days of care. The Lantern is lit for you, whatever you do tonight.
Your light has shone for {n} days. One light quest, only if you feel like it.
{n} days of small steps. Breathe: today, one is enough.
What a lovely journey: {n} days. One kind gesture tonight and it keeps shining.
{n} days beside the Lantern. No hurry, no judgement.
For {n} days you've chosen to show up. Tonight, if you wish, one quiet quest.
Your {n}-day streak is a little light. You can tend it gently.
{n} days of gentleness and constancy. The path stays open, always.
{n} days of light, one after another. One small step is enough, no hurry.
comeback: The Lantern is still lit for you. Come back whenever you like, no hurry.
No judgement, just a light that waits. One small quest and we begin again.
Every pause is part of the journey. Whenever you like, I'm here.
Your place beside the Lantern is always free. Come at your own pace.
There's nothing to explain. One small step and we start again together.
The light hasn't gone out. It waits for you, patiently.
Resting is walking too. Whenever you like, we restart with a light quest.
I was thinking of you, fondly. Come back when you feel like it.
There's no hurry in the heart of Calm. One step, whenever you like.
Today can be a new beginning. One quest, the smallest one.
weekly: The week opens calmly. The weekly quests wait for you, no hurry.
A new week, many small lights. Look at the weekly quests, gently.
The days of the week are a gentle path. Its quests walk with you.
Seven days for you, calmly. A weekly step is always welcome.
The Lantern lights the week. If you like, take a look at the weekly quests.
No rush: the week has room for everything. Your quests too.
A week is one long breath. The weekly quests are right there, serene.
One small weekly step is worth four daily ones. What a sweet bit of maths.
The week flows lightly. A thought for your quests, whenever you like.
Every week is a new beginning. The weekly quests wait for you kindly.
monthly: The month is a long breath. The monthly quests wait for you, no hurry.
A whole month ahead of you, calmly. Look at the monthly quests, whenever you like.
The great lights come on slowly. The monthly quests are right there, serene.
The month is a gentle path. The monthly quests light it up.
A monthly quest is worth twelve dailies. A small big step, if you like.
The Lantern lights the month. A thought for the monthly quests, gently.
No rush: the month has time for everything. Your quests too.
Great things grow slowly. The monthly quests wait for you, serene.
A month is a small journey. Its quests are kind companions.
If you feel like it, take a look at the month's quests today. Take all the time you need.
levelup: A new level: the Lantern shines a little brighter.
You took a lovely step. A new level greets you.
The light grows with you. New level, with gratitude.
One more level, born of small gestures. I'm so happy.
You shine a little brighter today. New level.
You kept the light, and the light grows. A new level.
One more gentle step up. Breathe and smile.
A new level, without hurry and with heart. What a lovely journey.
The Lantern lights up: a new level for you.
One step after another, the light carries far. New level.

morning: Curtain up! The day is a stage and your quests are the lines.
Good morning, audience! Today we go on: the first quest is already in the script.
The sun rises, the music starts: today's quests await your solo.
Glorious morning, city tour: first stop, one quest to get going.
The lute is tuned, the day is ready: wake up, we're going on stage.
Lights on, warm voice and a diary to sing: today's quests, the stage is yours!
A new day, a new act. What shall we call it? I'd suggest: Quests.
If the day is a stage, your first quest is the entrance.
Every morning is opening night: smile, bow and go with the first quest.
The audience is in, the day is already here. One quest and you're in full show.
evening: Final act: one more quest and the applause is guaranteed!
The curtain falls on the day: one last number is missing, will you sing it?
The stage lights are dimming: one quest and the finale is a standing ovation.
An encore is never denied. One quest and we finish in style.
The sunset paints the scene: last act, one more quest.
The audience awaits the grand finale. A quest and a bow, and the day is done.
Evening, curtain almost down: one last chorus and off to dinner.
A day of theatre, one last round of applause: one quest and you're a star.
One last verse before bed: evening asks for a quest, and it rhymes with rest.
Soon I'll put away the lute: one more quest and the night is legendary.
streak: {n} days of ballad! The audience waits, but no rush: one quest and an encore it is.
{n} days on tour: a round of applause for you! One last number tonight, if you like.
Your {n}-day streak is a work of art. Shall we add a verse before the curtain?
{n} days of melody: one note missing for tonight, and the rhyme is done.
Encore, encore! {n} days of show. One small quest and the curtain stays up.
{n} days of chorus: the audience sings with you. One quest and off to dinner.
You've got {n} days of applause in your pocket. Tonight a small bow: one quest.
{n} days of show and not one sour note. One quest and the evening is a standing ovation.
The playbill says {n} days in a row: marvellous! Add a line to the ballad?
{n} days of touring: one more verse, then the lute rests.
comeback: The stage is always free for you: come back whenever you like, and we restart with an encore.
I wrote a ballad about your absence. It's sad but has a happy ending: your return.
No scolding, just applause in advance: come back and we start again with one quest.
The audience is waiting patiently: one quest is enough to return to the stage.
A pause is an interval, and intervals always end with music. Come back whenever you like.
The lute is still tuned, and your front-row seat too. One step and the show restarts.
I'm waiting backstage with a warm voice and a smile: shall we restart?
The tour isn't over, it's just paused. One quest and it resumes.
I kept your front-row seat. Whenever you like, the curtain rises.
Your ballad is waiting for a new verse. One quest is enough to write it.
weekly: The week is a grand show: the weekly quests are the main numbers.
Seven days of touring! The weekly quests await your solo.
The week's playbill is ready: the weekly quests are on the programme.
A week, a stage, a few special quests: it's up to you to choose the scene.
The week's script is open: the weekly quests await you, encore included.
Week in progress, main act in sight: the weekly quests are applauding you.
One weekly deed is worth four dailies: a finale worthy of a theatre.
Weekly quests are the grand finale of the tour. Shall we sing them together?
The week's audience is in: one weekly quest and the applause begins.
Seven days, a thousand notes: the weekly quests are the finest.
monthly: The month is a theatre season: the monthly quests are the masterpieces on the bill.
A month of shows! The monthly quests await their big moment.
The month's curtain is up: the monthly quests are the stars of the night.
A month, an opera: the monthly quests are the finest aria.
Every month has its masterpiece. Yours? A monthly quest, and what applause!
The month's programme is full of surprises: look at the monthly quests.
Monthly quests are worth twelve dailies: grand theatre stuff!
The month is a season: its quests are songs to sing in many voices.
The month still has free scenes: a monthly quest fills them with glory.
Monthly quests are the encores of the month: few, but unforgettable.
levelup: Encore! New level, and the audience is on its feet!
A new level: the thunderous applause is all for you!
Curtain! You have a new level and a ballad of your own.
New level, new verse: the tour goes on, and what a tour!
The audience loves you, so does the lute: one more level on the poster.
You've won a new level: I dedicate a chorus to you, and it rhymes with glory.
A new level in the grand opera: the court master is proud.
Your name climbs the poster: new level, applause on the spot.
New level, new ballad: one more note in your score.
Hooray, one more step on the stage! We sing, we dance, we celebrate.

morning: > BOOT complete. 3 quests in queue. Execute? [Y/n]
> Good morning. System ready. Daily quests awaiting execution.
> STARTING morning sequence. First quest: whenever you like.
> Loading day... complete. Quests available: yes.
> System update: new day installed. Quests in queue.
> LOG: sun detected. Recommendation: complete one quest.
> Status: operational. Today's objectives: loaded. Proceed?
> Daily cycle started. Priority: daily quests.
> No errors detected this morning. A good time to begin.
> Run daily routine? [Y/n] Recommended answer: Y.
evening: > WARNING: quests not completed. Timeout in 3 hours.
> Evening detected. Quests in queue: still present. Execute?
> Daily memory almost full. Free it up with one quest?
> Evening recommendation: complete one quest before the cycle closes.
> LOG: sunset in progress. One quest can still be executed.
> The daily cycle ends soon. Remaining quests: available.
> Suggested action: one quest before system rest.
> Notice: day closing. Complete one quest? [Y/n]
> Day save imminent. One more quest improves the report.
> Night notification incoming. Evening quest still executable.
streak: > LOG: streak active for {n} days. Status: excellent. Evening quest available, no rush.
> {n} days of uptime. System stable. One optional quest improves the report.
> STREAK status: {n} days. No errors detected. Execute a quest? [Y/n]
> Update: {n} consecutive days. Recommendation: one quest, only if useful.
> {n} days of stable loop. The cabinet is on and the token is ready.
